description: Keeps large shell and tool results out of the context: bounded excerpts, full outputs kept by hash, paged reads, ranked search and doc fetch

result_bytes.title: Per-result budget
result_bytes.description: Bytes of one tool result delivered to the model before it is cut to an excerpt (1024-262144)

turn_bytes.title: Per-turn budget
turn_bytes.description: Bytes of tool results delivered in one turn before every further result is cut to the floor (4096-1048576)

floor_bytes.title: Excerpt floor
floor_bytes.description: Excerpt size once the per-turn budget is spent (1024-65536)
